title: Betelgeuse's Great Dimming Hid Half Its Face
hook: Betelgeuse looked ready to die, but the images told a stranger story.
closing: One dramatic fade can mislead us about what a star is actually doing.
question: Would that dimming fool you?

segments.say: Betelgeuse fell to 36 percent of normal brightness. A familiar star suddenly looked alarmingly faint.
Images showed 50 percent of Betelgeuse obscured. The observation supports hidden light without claiming the star was dying.
Its estimated supernova remains 100,000 years away. A brief fade and stellar death run on wildly different clocks.
